glosses: to demonize (to describe or represent as evil or diabolic)

examples.text: Nie demonizuj zagrożenia ze strony tsunami, bo mieszkasz w Zakopanem.

glosses: To describe or represent as evil or diabolic, usually falsely.

examples.text: President Trump has seized on the response in the streets to police brutality against Black men and women to bolster his re-election campaign, employing provocative and sometimes incendiary language and images to incite his followers, demonize his opponents or both.
He calls for a “massive, urgent recruitment effort,” which is a fine idea, but one that’s likely to be futile unless we stop demonizing teachers and start paying them fairly.

Many people disagree with several things society has normalized, some of which are even demonized. Frustratingly, attaching a stigma to perfectly reasonable things makes people feel attacked when they publicly do them.

glosses: zur Ursache allen Übels erklären, schlecht machen, verunglimpfen

examples.text: Er wurde ganz zu Unrecht verteufelt.
Er wird nicht verteufelt, wohl aber deutlich kritisiert.
„Von den Medien durchgekaut, verteufelt und verketzert, für Politiker oftmals ein willkommener Dreschflegel, um viel leeres Stroh zu dreschen.“
„Die See, das «schwarze Wasser» (kala pani), war von den Brahmanen verteufelt worden, die die Rettung der indischen Kultur in einer Abschirmung gegenüber der Außenwelt sahen.“
